entries.title: Faeon
entries.content: Faeon is a mystical land rife with thousands of years of history and cultures between diverse fantasy races. The realm is primarily made of one giant continent that houses a deep variety of landscapes and settings that reflect the beings that inhabit them. While there are many different factions and nations, there are deep pockets of unexplored regions filled with mysterious spirits or mythical creatures.

entries.title: Lythien - Elf Capital
entries.content: Lythien, nestled deep within ancient forests to the southwest of Sentinel Spine, is the serene homeland of beautiful Elves, renowned for their mastery of magic and affinity with nature. Governed by the Council of Elders, Lythien stands as a bastion of wisdom and tranquility amidst the tumultuous realms of the mortal races. Enemies of the orcs, neutral with most. Hiva's home.

entries.title: Sentinel Spine - Center of Faeon
entries.content: [The Sentinel Spine: A colossal mountain range that stretches across regions, bridging the lands of Faeon. It serves as both a natural barrier and forms bandit filled pathways, uniting diverse peoples and cultures while safeguarding Faeon inhabitants from ancient threats to its south. It stands in the direct center of Faeon.]

entries.title: Snowdrift Plains
